Ta có $\displaystyle V = \pi \int_0^{\frac{\pi}{3}} (y)^2 \text{d}x = \pi \int_0^{\frac{\pi}{3}} \tan^2 x \, \text{d}x$. \\
		Mà $\displaystyle \tan^2 x = \frac{1}{\cos^2 x} - 1$. \\
		$\displaystyle \Rightarrow V = \pi \int_0^{\frac{\pi}{3}} \left( \frac{1}{\cos^2 x} - 1 \right) \text{d}x$ \\
		$\displaystyle = \pi (\tan x - x) \Big|_0^{\frac{\pi}{3}} = \pi \left( \tan \frac{\pi}{3} - \frac{\pi}{3} - (\tan 0 - 0) \right)$. \\
		$\displaystyle = \pi \left( \sqrt{3} - \frac{\pi}{3} \right)$. \\
		Vậy $\displaystyle V = \pi\sqrt{3} - \frac{\pi^2}{3}$. \\
